prompted_for: 'Your first Purified Water system' section on the Industries page; art direction: editorial magazine spread, oversized typography, dramatic asymmetric composition, one striking illustration; five facts: product grade, what it covers and costs, running cost, team's first year, who you work with
composition: full-width navy band at top with a huge light caps two-line headline
left 45%: a large geometric collage of pipes, tanks, arrows, spirals and a water drop built from flat navy, steel-blue and limestone shapes
right 55%: five fact blocks arranged in an irregular grid separated by thin vertical and horizontal rules with elbows
one navy block bottom right for the team
breadcrumb and small wordmark in the header band
layout_devices: asymmetric editorial grid of fact blocks with stepped rule lines
small caps block labels (THE GRADE, THE SCOPE, YEAR ONE...)
large figures as block heads (PW, POTABLE, 1YR 365d)
dotted leader rows for cost lines
mini bar meters for staff hours
headline band overlapping the collage top
palette: deep navy header band and team block
steel-blue collage shapes and large figures
typography: huge light-to-regular caps grotesk headline (wide, spaced)
mono figures for codes and prices (GUI-0001, $180k)
line_and_texture: concentric arcs and spirals in collage
motion_implied: collage pieces slide and assemble into the system
t2i_keywords: abstract pipes tanks spirals and arrows from flat shapes
deep navy steel blue and limestone shapes
t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup, editorial magazine spread. A full-width deep navy band at the top holds an oversized wide caps headline. On a limestone ground below, the left half is one striking geometric collage illustration built from flat navy, steel-blue and limestone shapes: pipes, elbows, tanks, spirals, an arrow and a water drop, like a modernist paper cut-out poster. The right half is an asymmetric grid of fact blocks for <CONTENT>, small caps labels, large accent figures, monospace codes, dotted leader rows and mini bar meters, joined by thin elbowed rules.
signature_idea: The water system becomes a modernist paper-cut collage of pipes and tanks, set beside an editorial fact sheet for first-time buyers.
strengths: collage is distinctive and ownable while staying in the navy/steel-blue/limestone palette
flat vector shapes are cheap to build as SVG and animate
fact blocks with labels give first-time buyers a scannable overview
weaknesses: all-caps headline breaks sentence-case Geist light rule
irregular block grid and elbow rules feel crowded on the right
invented prices and staff-hour meters could mislead (should be placeholders)
collage abstraction loses the precise technical-drawing character
steel blue used as a fill, not only for lines and one highlight
brand_fit_why: Palette, flat fills, square corners and mono figures fit, but all-caps headline, heavy use of steel-blue fill and poster-collage abstraction depart from the calm, precise line-art brand.
